title: Blue Mountain Beach "Fairhaven" formerly known as Suncats 29 Ashley Lane
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Fairhaven" formerly known as Suncats 29 Ashley Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 4 Adult bikes- Close proximity to trails and lakes- Community pool *Please note that the pool in Lakeside is closed from now until Late March or April for renovations- Propane grill- Extended stay- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Welcome to Fairhaven, a 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom Blue Mountain Beach hideaway that comfortably accommodates 10. Aptly named, this 2-story home offers a delightful 30A escape for savoring unhurried days by the community pool, daily trips to nearby Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, and fun on the Gulf! Guests will love the tranquil outdoor spaces perfect for lounging, the inviting interior that encourages time together, and the fantastic location—only a 15-minute walk from the beach!This charming retreat welcomes guests with a sea-green exterior and a spacious front porch, furnished with a bar-style table for 8. Inside, blonde wood floors stretch throughout the open great room, illuminated by ample natural light. Velvety powder blue seating and beachy accents create a cozy spot for guests to sit back and relax while watching TV. Behind the living area, a beautiful kitchen with granite countertops and high-end appliances offers plenty of counter space for cooking, including an expansive island that seats 5. To the side is a live-edge dining table with 4 chairs and built-in bench seating, where guests can enjoy homemade meals and friendly game nights. The laundry room features a convenient sink for rinsing swimsuits. Continue outside to find a brick patio with Adirondack seating and a patio table, tucked behind lush foliage. Sip coffee in the morning breeze, cocktails at night, and afternoon barbecues on the grill around the corner. A sleeper sofa in the living room provides sleeping accommodations on this level.All the home’s bedrooms are located on the second level, boasting colorful décor and comfy accommodations. Discover a king bed, private bathroom, and a covered, furnished balcony—with a whimsical hanging egg chair—in the peaceful primary bedroom. The 2 guest bedrooms each feature a queen bed, and kids will love the bunk room’s twin-over-twin bed.Enjoy restful outdoor spaces and relaxing beach days at Fairhaven in Blue Mountain Beach. On-site parking, plus 4 complimentary adult bikes, makes it easy to explore nearby neighborhoods. For the nearest beach access, visit Blue Mountain Beach Access at the end of Old Blue Mountain Road. Book today!
